blurb: Is a new exhibition space and center for the study of art located on the Aspen Institute’s campus. Named after Herbert Bayer (1900-1985)-an influential modern artist and designer who worked at the Bauhaus before relocating to Aspen in 1946-the Bayer Center honors his interdisciplinary perspective by promoting an understanding of art and design through exhibitions, educational initiatives, and public programming.
